title: Anonymous shirt retailer stimulus (CXL image-size research): product image size (loss)
company: Anonymous shirt retailer stimulus (CXL image-size research)

change.control: Smaller shirt product image in the original minimal PDP layout, with prices removed.
change.variant: Enlarge the same shirt image within the same layout, holding logo and content constant.

quote: The smaller image actually produced a higher perceived value
notes: Original shirt source priced $145 before price removal. Bargain-question two-sided p=0.012; too-expensive p=0.117. Three shirt-layout tests are different research comparisons, not live retail experiments. US general-population survey; 2,982 participants across all eight treatments, not a count for this comparison. No sales or conversion effect measured.
